items.q: Which plant hormone promotes cell elongation?
items.explain: Auxin stimulates cell elongation in shoots and roots.
items.explainAf: Auksien stimuleer seldeurlopie in lote en wortels.

items.q: Which hormone is associated with fruit ripening?
items.qAf: Watter hormoon word met vrugrypwording geassosieer?
items.explain: Ethene is a gaseous hormone that triggers ripening.
items.explainAf: Eteen is ’n gasvormige hormoon wat rypwording veroorsaak.

items.explain: Abscisic acid promotes dormancy and closes stomata during water stress.
items.explainAf: Abssiensuur bevorder rusperiode en sluit huidmondjies tydens waterstremming.

items.explain: Phototropism is directional growth in response to light.
items.explainAf: Fototropisme is rigtinggroei in reaksie op lig.

items.q: Auxin accumulates on the shaded side of a shoot. What is the result?
items.qAf: Auksien hoop op aan die skaduwee kant van ’n lot. Wat is die gevolg?
options: The shoot bends towards the light
The shoot bends away from the light
optionsAf: The shoot bends towards the light
The shoot bends away from the light
items.explain: Higher auxin on the shaded side makes those cells elongate more, so the shoot bends towards the light.
items.explainAf: Meer auksien aan die skaduwee kant laat daardie selle meer rek, sodat die lot na die lig buig.

items.q: Roots show positive gravitropism. In which direction does the root grow?
items.qAf: Wortels toon positiewe gravitropisme. In watter rigting groei die wortel?
items.explain: Roots grow towards the pull of gravity.
items.explainAf: Wortels groei in die rigting van die swaartekrag.

items.q: A growth movement of a plant in response to a directional stimulus.
items.qAf: ’n Groeibeweging van ’n plant in reaksie op ’n rigtingstimulus.

items.q: The plant hormone that causes cell elongation and is made in the growing tip.
items.qAf: Die planthormoon wat selverlenging veroorsaak en in die groeipunt gemaak word.

items.q: The plant hormone that causes fruit to ripen.
items.qAf: Die planthormoon wat vrugte laat ryp word.

items.text: Auxins move to the [[]] side of a stem, so those cells grow longer and the stem bends [[]] the light.
items.textAf: Ouksiene beweeg na die [[]] kant van ’n stingel, dus groei daardie selle langer en buig die stingel [[]] die lig.

items.qAf: Wortels groei na swaartekrag toe (positiewe geotropisme).
items.explain: True. In roots, high auxin concentrations inhibit growth on the lower side, so the root bends down.
items.explainAf: Waar. In wortels inhibeer hoë ouksienkonsentrasies groei aan die onderkant, dus buig die wortel af.

items.explain: False. Abscisic acid inhibits germination and causes stomata to close; gibberellins stimulate germination.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Absisiensuur inhibeer ontkieming en laat huidmondjies sluit; gibberelliene stimuleer ontkieming.

items.q: Match each plant hormone in column A with one of its functions in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke planthormoon in kolom A by een van sy funksies in kolom B.

items.q: Explain why gardeners cut off the tip of a plant to make it bushier.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom tuiniers die punt van ’n plant afsny om dit bossiger te maak.
points: The tip makes auxin, which inhibits the growth of side buds (apical dominance).
When the tip is removed, the side buds grow into branches.
pointsAf: Die punt maak ouksien, wat die groei van sykoppe inhibeer (apikale dominansie).
Wanneer die punt verwyder word, groei die sykoppe in takke uit.
